pages.text: “Deep red petals glow softly under the moonlight, carrying a gentle radiance.”$(br2)Verbena Tea is a delicately fragrant beverage made from dried verbena and sugar. The tea has a translucent purple hue. Drinking it grants Night Vision, allowing travelers to see clearly in the darkness.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Verbena Tea, $(br)boil dried verbena with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed during nighttime adventures or deep cave explorations, ensuring that darkness is no longer an obstacle.

Upon drinking Verbena Tea, travelers gain the Night Vision effect, making dark environments clear and visible.$(br)This tea is ideal for nighttime exploration, allowing adventurers to traverse the dark without fear.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
